data.positioning_statement: For property developers who sell on view and lifestyle, Vantyx is the immersive 360° tour platform that lets buyers step onto any floor at any time of day — and lets your team keep every view true to the rising building, without downtime. Unlike static renders or one-off 360 shoots, Vantyx is a living sales tool you update yourself as the project evolves.
data.frame_of_reference: Not a one-time 360 shoot and not a CGI render — a continuously-maintained, self-serve sales experience.
points_of_difference: Living updates: builders re-upload floor views as construction rises, themselves
Non-destructive + zero-downtime: the live tour never breaks mid-update
Always true to today: the real current view, not a years-old capture or a render
data.category_design: Defines the 'living property tour' — the tour that stays as true as the building it sells.
